Plan your space

Plan your space.

A useful brief begins with everyday life: what works, what gets in the way, and what your space needs to become.

01

Start with your day.

Describe how you use the space now. Include the routines, people, and moments the design needs to accommodate. Think about the parts of your day that deserve more room.

02

Set the priorities.

Separate essentials from possibilities. Share the budget range, timing, and constraints so the first conversation has a clear starting point. A short list of priorities is more useful than a long list of references.

03

Bring the context.

Gather photographs, available drawings, and a few references. Explain what you like about each reference: the light, layout, materials, or feeling. Bring questions about the site as well as ideas for the design.
